title: Bob Lazar on parallel engineering

tellings.quote: even if you talk to Bob Lazar and you go deep enough with him, it's not really reverse engineering, it's like parallel engineering.

related.note: Same subject as Lazar's S4 work, but the core claim is that it was parallel engineering rather than reverse engineering of crashed craft, which contradicts the story's account.

plain: What happens at secret US sites may not really be the copying of captured alien craft, which is called reverse engineering. It may be closer to "parallel engineering", building something alongside them. Michels says this is what Bob Lazar tells you if you go deep enough with him. Lazar is a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. Michels links the idea to the musician Tom DeLonge and his book series Sekret Machines.
